localGeometryAndArithmetic.conclusion: Ranger Beast is HP-only for ordinary zero-HP damage. The ordinary branch kills the same animal, ends the bond and leaves its actual corpse; no Wound save, ordinary Dying/death-save sequence or Stable recovery is invented. The qualifying Null branch instead retains the same Disabled0 animal and bond under the accepted specific exception. The independently eligible Synaptic rider and its source-only attached phase do not create ordinary turns or death saves.

recomputed.ordinaryOutcome: HP0; actual death; bond ended; real corpse
recomputed.nullOutcome: same animal and bond; NullDisabled0; no damage-caused Wound/death; legal HP recovery above0 remains source-qualified

localGeometryAndArithmetic.conclusion: Moving the suppressor off the actual cannon removes the overlapping-body defect while keeping the real paid Ready, release-point selection, command-loss, shot, ammunition and absolute source deadlines unchanged. Six feet of separation avoids a new close-quarters disadvantage on the later mortar shot. Destruction is expressly an independent admitted object-damage composition input, not a newly authored attack.

localGeometryAndArithmetic.conclusion: 105 was already the correct Warrior10/CON16 fixed HP maximum. The local repair adds the actual d12/chronological source derivation rather than changing the number. Actual BT, Adaptive Tissue, Spinal Plating, paid serum, strain, equipment-slot and area-versus-weapon predicates are retained. Prior acquisition, earlier critical exposure, BT generation and completed recovery are explicit initial-state premises, not free actions supplied by Ice Storm.
